scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Welcome to Christopher's Workshop. Ye can get all yer stuff for forging here. What business
brings ye to me?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
欢迎来克里斯托弗工坊，锻造用的东西这里应有尽有。
找我有什么事？

scripts.text: Purchase Anvil
scripts.translation: 购买铁砧

scripts.text: Purchase Forging Item
scripts.translation: 购买锻造工具

scripts.text: Purchase Metal
scripts.translation: 购买金属

scripts.text: Purify Rough Ores
scripts.translation: 提纯粗矿石

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
A better Anvil gives ye a greeeater chance to make better weapons, ye know? But they'll cost ye more zeny. Just get it off yer chest and buy what fits your purposes best, laddy.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
你知道的，更好的铁砧能大大增加锻造出优质武器的几率，但价格也会更贵。
别客气，挑个最适合你的吧，伙计。

scripts.text: Anvil - 30,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 铁砧 - 30,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Oridecon Anvil - 120,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 神之金属铁砧 - 120,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Golden Anvil - 300,000 zeny
scripts.translation: 黄金铁砧 - 300,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Better Anvil than the others.
scripts.translation: 还有更好的铁砧吗

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I don't think I can let ye have this with the zeny ye have. I can't lose me money because of ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
你这点Zeny可买不起，我总不能赔本卖吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
This is the cheapest one, but efficient enough to forge most items. Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop.  Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
这是最便宜的一款，但足以锻造大多数物品。
感谢光临我的工作室。随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I don't think I can let ye have this with the zeny ye have. I can't lose me money because of ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
你这点Zeny可买不起，我总不能赔本卖吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Aye, friend ye have an eye for the anvil. This must be the proper anvil for a Blacksmith, eh? Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop.  Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
哎呀，朋友，你很有眼光嘛。这绝对是铁匠该用的铁砧，对吧？
感谢光临我的工作室。随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I don't think I can let ye have this with the zeny ye have. I can't lose me money because of ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
你这点Zeny可买不起，我总不能赔本卖吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
This one is the best among all me stuffs in me workshop! With this, ye can rule the Blacksmith world! Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop.  Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
这是我工作室里所有物品中最好的！有了它，你就能称霸铁匠界了！
感谢光临我的工作室。随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Well, sorry. But I don't have anythin' harder' than the Golden Anvil.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
嗯，抱歉。但我这里没有比黄金铁砧更硬的铁砧了。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Me thinks 'Ringgel,' the Legendary Anvil Maker would have one. But, I don't think ye can find him, though he be somewhere in this world.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
传说中的铁砧大师“林格尔”那里也许有。
不过，虽然他就在这世上的某个地方，你恐怕很难找到。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Okay, feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
好的，随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我。再见。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
A respectable blacksmith uses fine tools. Ye can become one o'those with me Stuff. Choose anything ye want.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
好铁匠得用好工具，用我的工具，你也能成为受人敬重的铁匠。
看中什么就挑吧。

scripts.text: Mini-Furnace - 150 zeny
scripts.translation: 迷你熔炉 - 150 Zeny

scripts.text: Iron Hammer - 1000 zeny
scripts.translation: 钢铁锤子 - 1000 Zeny

scripts.text: Golden Hammer - 3000 zeny
scripts.translation: 黄金锤子 - 3000 Zeny

scripts.text: Oridecon Hammer - 5000 zeny
scripts.translation: 神之金属锤子 - 5000 Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
It's a much needed tool fer refining metal! So, How many do ye wish to buy? If ye want to quit, just type the number '0.'
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
提炼金属可少不了它！
要买几个？想取消就输入0。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Aye, the deal is canceled. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
好的，交易已取消。再见。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Ye can buy 500, er less.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
最多买500个。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I don't think I can let ye have this with the zeny ye have. I can't lose me money because of ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
你这点Zeny可买不起，我总不能赔本卖吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Ye look like you don't got enough room in yer inventory. Put some stuff into your Kafra Storage, why don't ye?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
背包空间好像不够了，先把一些东西存进卡普拉仓库吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop. Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
感谢你在我的工坊购物。随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我。

scripts.text:

随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我。再见。

[Christopher Guillenrow]
I prepare every Metal, and only the high quality ones o'course. Now then, which one do ye need?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
我备有各种金属，当然都是高品质的。那么，你需要哪一种？

scripts.translation: 强化武器金属-级数一 - 200 Zeny

scripts.text: Emveretarcon - 1000z.

Deal has

Fare ye well.

交易已取消。
再见。

Ye can buy 500, er less.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
最多买500个。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Ye don't have enough money. Ye know I can't sell this at a lower price... You know how the wifey nags about Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
你的钱不够，可别指望我降价...
我老婆成天为Zeny念叨个不停。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Ye look like you don't have the room to carry anythin' new. Why don't ye put some things into Kafra Storage n' come back.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
你背包装不下新东西了，先把一些存进卡普拉仓库，再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Me friend... Seems to me ye don't have Inventory space. Why doncha put some things into Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
朋友...背包空间不够了，先存点东西进卡普拉仓库吧。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Thank ye fer shopping at me workshop. Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need, whenever ye want.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
感谢你在我的工坊购物。随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我，想什么时候来就什么时候来。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我。再见。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I can purify yer Oridecon and Elunium. I make a refined Ore out of 5 o'each rough ones. Well... Which one do ye want to make?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
我能帮你提炼神之金属和铝，每5个同类原石炼成1个成品。
想炼哪种？

scripts.text: Make Oridecon
scripts.translation: 制作神之金属

scripts.text: Make Elunium
scripts.translation: 制作铝

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I told ye, I need 5 o'the rough Oridecons fer one Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
我说过，我需要5个神之金属原石才能制成1个神之金属。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Here's an Oridecon fer ye. Ye will be always welcome here, I'll be waitin' for ye.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
这是你的神之金属。这里永远欢迎你的到来，我会一直在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
I told ye, I need 5 rough Eluniums fer one Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
我说过，我需要5个铝原石才能制成1个铝。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Arrr, here's yer Elunium. Yer business is always welcome here, so feel free to come again.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
啊，这是你的铝。这里永远欢迎你的光顾，请随时再来。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
随时欢迎再来，有需要尽管找我。再见。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Guillenrow]
Feel free to come anytime, whenever ye need and whenever ye want. Fare ye well.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·吉伦罗]
有需要，或是想来了，随时来找我。
再见。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你携带的物品太多了。 -
- 请减轻负重后再试。 -

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Welcome, my friend.
In my shop, you will find everything that you need in forging.
Tell me what you need.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
欢迎，我的朋友。
在我的店里，你能找到锻造所需的一切。
请告诉我你需要什么。

scripts.text: Purchase Anvil.
scripts.translation: 购买铁砧

scripts.text: Purchase Forging Items.
scripts.translation: 购买锻造材料

scripts.text: Purchase Metal.
scripts.translation: 购买金属

scripts.text: Process Ores.
scripts.translation: 提纯矿石

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Anvil is the most necessary item for Blacksmiths.
Since you will use an Anvil more than once, you'd better buy a nice one.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
铁砧是铁匠不可或缺的工具。
要长期使用，最好买个好一些的。

scripts.text: Anvil - 30,000z.
Oridecon Anvil - 120,000z.
scripts.translation: 神之金属铁砧 - 120,000z

scripts.text: Golden Anvil - 300,000z.
I need a better anvil.
scripts.translation: 我需要更好的铁砧

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
With that much of money, you cannot even buy a toy anvil!
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
就这点钱，连玩具铁砧都买不起！

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
It is the cheapest anvil which has the most basic ability.
Thank you for using my shop. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
这是最便宜的铁砧，具备最基本的功能。
感谢光顾我的店铺。如果你需要任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
With that much of money, you cannot even buy a toy anvil!
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
就这点钱，连玩具铁砧都买不起！

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Ah, you have an eye for anvil. A Blacksmith needs an anvil at least as good as this.
Thank you for using my shop. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
啊，你很有眼光。铁匠至少需要这样质量的铁砧。
感谢光顾我的店铺。如果你需要任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
With that much of money, you cannot even buy a toy anvil!
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
就这点钱，连玩具铁砧都买不起！

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can tell your ambition to become a good Blacksmith just by looking at you to choose this Golden Anvil!
This anvil will surely aid you in creating the best weapons.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
看你选黄金铁砧，就知道你有志成为优秀的铁匠！
它一定能帮你打造出最出色的武器。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I am sorry, but I do not sell better anvils than Golden Anvil.
Unless you find the legendary anvil of 'Linggell', I don't think that you could find better one than Golden Anvil in any other places.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
很抱歉，我这里没有比黄金铁砧更好的铁砧了。
除非你能找到传说中的“林格尔”铁砧，否则我想你在别处也找不到比黄金铁砧更好的了。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
如果你需要任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You need various materials to process ores and to forge weapons.
I have everything that you need. Take a look.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
你需要各种材料来加工矿石和锻造武器。
我这里应有尽有。请看看。

You definitely need this furnace to process ores!

If you need anything, just let me know.

You have canceled the trade. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:

你已取消交易。如果你需要任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You can only buy 500 or less at a time.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
一次最多买500个。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
You don't have enough money. Sorry, I cannot sell them at a loss.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
你的Zeny不足。抱歉，我不能亏本卖给你。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Hey, you look pale. Why don't you go lighten your weight first.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
嘿，你脸色不太好，先去减轻点负重吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Thank you for using my shop. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
感谢光顾我的店铺。如果你需要任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

So, which metal would you like to buy?

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
你的Zeny不足。抱歉，我不能亏本卖给你。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Hey, you look pale. Why don't you go lighten your weight first?
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
嘿，你脸色不太好，先去减轻点负重吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
Thank you for using my shop. If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
感谢光顾我的店铺。如果你需要任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can process Oridecon and Elunium for you.
You need 5 ores to process them into one Oridecon or Elunium.
So, which one do you want to process?
[Paul Spanner]
You need 5 ores to process them into one pure Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
我能帮你提炼神之金属和铝，每5个同类原石炼成1个成品。
想炼哪种？
[保罗·斯潘纳]
5个神之金属原石才能炼成1个纯净的神之金属。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can process Oridecon and Elunium for you.
You need 5 ores to process them into one Oridecon or Elunium.
So, which one do you want to process?
[Paul Spanner]
There you go. Thank you for using my service.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
我能帮你提炼神之金属和铝，每5个同类原石炼成1个成品。
想炼哪种？
[保罗·斯潘纳]
给你，感谢使用我的服务。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can process Oridecon and Elunium for you.
You need 5 ores to process them into one Oridecon or Elunium.
So, which one do you want to process?
[Paul Spanner]
You need 5 ores to process them into one pure Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
我能帮你提炼神之金属和铝，每5个同类原石炼成1个成品。
想炼哪种？
[保罗·斯潘纳]
5个铝原石才能炼成1个纯净的铝。

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
I can process Oridecon and Elunium for you.
You need 5 ores to process them into one Oridecon or Elunium.
So, which one do you want to process?
[Paul Spanner]
If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
我能帮你提炼神之金属和铝，每5个同类原石炼成1个成品。
想炼哪种？
[保罗·斯潘纳]
有需要，尽管告诉我。

scripts.text: Oridecon
scripts.translation: 神之金属

scripts.text: Elunium
scripts.translation: 铝

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Paul Spanner]
If you need anything, just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[保罗·斯潘纳]
如果你需要任何帮助，请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn]
I'm a blacksmith who can refine weapons and equipment.
Do you have any items that you'd like to refine?
scripts.translation:
[霍尔格雷恩]
我是一名可以精炼武器和装备的铁匠。
你有想要精炼的物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Aragham]
De~ sert~ Blacksmith~
Aragham Ssaleh~ who can refine anything Ssaleh~
Let me see what you'd like to refine~
scripts.translation:
[阿拉甘]
沙~漠~铁匠~
阿拉甘 Ssaleh~什么都能精炼 Ssaleh~
让我看看，你想精炼什么~

scripts.text:
[Antonio]
Stop nagging and get me the equipment you want to refine.
scripts.translation:
[安东尼奥]
别唠叨了，把你想要精炼的装备拿来。

scripts.text:
[Fredrik Hermanthorn]
I am a blacksmith who can refine your weapon or equipment.
Do you have anything that you'd like to refine?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德里克·赫曼索恩]
我是一名可以精炼你武器或装备的铁匠。
你有想要精炼的物品吗？

scripts.text:
[Lambert]
Wel...come... This is... the best... smithy... in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[兰伯特]
欢...迎...光临...这里是...朱诺...最好的...铁匠铺...

scripts.text:
[Manthasman Pruhag]
Hahaha, you already knew it. So you'd like to refine something?
Let's try something risky today!
scripts.translation:
[曼塔斯曼·普鲁哈格]
Hahaha，你早就知道了吧，想精炼点什么？
今天来冒个险吧！

scripts.text:
[Fulerr]
Hehe... You wanna refine?
Hehe.. Consider it done..
Hehe....
scripts.translation:
[富勒尔]
Hehe...想精炼？
Hehe..包在我身上..
Hehe....

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the Armsmith.
I can refine all kinds of weapons, armor and equipment, so let me
know what you want me to refine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是武器匠。
我可以精炼各种武器、防具和装备，请告诉我你想让我精炼什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can refine any items you have...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得你身上没有我可以精炼的物品...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're not wearing
anything there that
I can refine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你没穿戴可以精炼的装备。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think I can
refine this item at all...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这件物品恐怕没法精炼...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't refine this
any more. This is as
refined as it gets!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
已经不能再精炼了，这是最高精炼等级！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
To refine this I need
one ^003366{1}^000000 and
a service fee of {2} Zeny.
Do you really wish to continue?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
精炼需要1个^003366{1}^000000，以及{2} Zeny服务费。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah...
There's no need to
rush. Take your time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...不用急，慢慢考虑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no! If I continue to
refine this, there's a risk it could
be destroyed! That means that ^FF0000this equipment^000000, and ^FF0000any cards^000000 or special properties added to this armor, ^FF0000will be gone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再继续精炼，就有损毁的风险！
也就是说，^FF0000这件装备^000000、镶嵌的^FF0000所有卡片^000000以及附加在防具上的特殊属性，^FF0000都会消失^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh no! If I continue to
refine this, there's a risk it could
be destroyed, and you'd ^FF0000lose the weapon^000000, any ^FF0000cards in the weapon^000000,
or any added special properties.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再继续精炼，就有损毁的风险！
届时你会^FF0000失去武器^000000、^FF0000镶嵌在武器里的所有卡片^000000，以及附加的特殊属性。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't make it any clearer.
Once a weapon is destroyed,
there's no getting it back.
You really have a chance to
^FF0000lose this weapon^000000 forever.
Do you still want to refine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已经说得很清楚了，武器一旦损毁，就再也找不回来。
你可能^FF0000永远失去这把武器^000000。
还要继续精炼吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I completely agree...
I might be a great refiner, but sometimes even I make mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我完全同意...
虽然我可能是个很棒的精炼师，但有时候连我也会犯错。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You don't seem to have
enough Zeny or {1}...
Go get some more. I'll be
here all day if you need me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的Zeny或{1}不够...
再去准备些吧，我整天都在这儿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下...
你觉得我傻吗？！
趁我不注意你换了物品！给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OH! MY GOD!
Damn it! Not again!
I'm terribly sorry, but you know practice does make perfect.
Um, right? Heh heh...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！该死，又失败了！
真对不起，不过熟能生巧嘛。
嗯，对吧？Heh heh...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nooooooo!
It broke!
I-I'm sorry!

[{0}]
Crap!
It couldn't take
much more tempering!
Sorry about this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟了！
它承受不住更多的淬炼了！
对此我很抱歉...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Perfect!
Heh heh!
Once again,
flawless work
from the master~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
完美！Heh heh!
大师又完成了一件无可挑剔的杰作~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Success...!
Yet again, my amazing
talent truly dazzles
and shines today.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
成功...！
今天，我惊人的才华再次大放异彩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Heh heh!
I'm all done.
No doubt, my work is
to your satisfaction.
Sheer, utter perfection~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
Heh heh!完成了。
你一定满意，简直完美无缺~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can refine this to the safe limit or a desired number of times. It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以精炼到安全上限或指定的次数。由你选择。

scripts.text: To the safe limit, please.
scripts.translation: 请精炼到安全上限

scripts.text: I'll decide how many times.
scripts.translation: 我来决定次数

scripts.text: I've changed my mind...
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How many times would you like me to refine your item?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想让我精炼你的物品多少次？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't refine this item that many times.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我无法精炼这个物品那么多次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This will try to refine the equipment {1} times past the safe limit. Your equipment may be destroyed... is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这将尝试在安全上限之外再精炼{1}次。你的装备可能会被破坏...这样可以吗？

scripts.text: Yes...
scripts.translation: 是的...

scripts.text: No...

[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你这么说...那就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你这么说...那就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That will cost you {1} {2} and {3} Zeny. Is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
需要{1}个{2}和{3} Zeny，可以吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No...

[{0}]
You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你这么说...那就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that all you got? Unfortunately I can't work for you at a lower price. Try putting yourself in my shoes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就这些？抱歉，我不能少收钱。
也替我想想吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look here... you don't have any items on...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂...你根本没穿戴装备...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Clang... No, but did you imagine I could be so stupid?!
You changed it...
Get out before I stun you with my Hammer!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
Clang...你以为我有那么蠢吗？！
你把装备换了...
趁我还没拿锤子敲晕你，赶紧滚！！

scripts.text:
Clang, clang!!!
[{0}]
WAHHHH!!! I'm so sorry... I warned you this could happen...
scripts.translation:
Clang, clang!!!
[{0}]
WAHHHH!!!真对不起...我提醒过你，可能会发生这种事...

scripts.text:
Clang, clang!!!
[{0}]
WAHHHH!!! I'm so sorry... I warned you this could happen...
Here's the unused Zeny and materials back...
scripts.translation:
Clang, clang!!!
[{0}]
WAHHHH!!!真对不起...我提醒过你，可能会发生这种事...
没用完的Zeny和材料，还给你...

scripts.text: Clang, clang!!!
scripts.translation: Clang, clang!!!

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All finished... Come again soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
全部完成了...欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你携带的物品太多了。 -
- 请减轻负重后再试。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I sell 2 kinds of Metal
for tempering weaponry.
I have ^007777Phracon^000000 for Level 1
Weapons, and ^007777Emveretarcon^000000
for Level 2 Weapons.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我出售两种用于强化武器的金属。
我有^007777强化武器金属-级数一^000000，用于1级武器，
以及^007777强化武器金属-级数二^000000，用于2级武器。

scripts.text: Phracon - 200 Zeny
scripts.translation: 强化武器金属-级数一 - 200 Zeny

scripts.text: Emveretarcon - 1000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 强化武器金属-级数二 - 1000 Zeny

scripts.text: Ask about other Metals
scripts.translation: 询问其他金属

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Other metals?
Well, you'll need special metals to upgrade higher level weapons, or any kind of armor. But you know, Oridecon and Elunium is really
hard to just find...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其他金属？
精炼高级武器或防具，需要特殊金属，不过神之金属和铝可不好找...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So how many do you wish to buy?
If you don't want any, please enter the number, '0.'
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么你想买多少呢？
如果你不想买，请输入数字“0”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The deal has
been cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
交易已取消。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, you can
puchase up to 500.
No more than that,
got it? Good.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，你最多可以购买500个。
不能超过这个数量，明白了吗？很好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Err...
You don't have
enough Zeny to buy
{1} of them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...
你的Zeny不够购买{1}个。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
I can't give you anything if you don't have enough room in your inventory. Why don't you put your extra things in Kafra Storage and try again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
背包空间不够，我可没法把东西给你。
先把多余物品存进卡普拉仓库，再来试试。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you are!
Thank you for
your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你！
感谢惠顾。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你携带的物品太多了。 -
- 请减轻负重后再试。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can purify your
Rough Oridecons or
Rough Eluniums. I'll need
5 Rough Stones to make
1 pure one for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以提纯你的神之金属原石或铝原石。
我需要5块原石才能为你制作1块纯金属。

scripts.text: Make Oridecon
scripts.translation: 制作神之金属

scripts.text: Make Elunium
scripts.translation: 制作铝

scripts.text: Ask about Enchanted Stones
scripts.translation: 询问属性原石

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here's your Oridecon.
You're welcome to come
back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的神之金属。
欢迎随时回来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're kidding me, right?
I just told you that I need 5 Rough Oridecons to make a pure Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在开玩笑吧？
我刚才才告诉你，我需要5块神之金属原石才能制作1块纯神之金属。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here's your Elunium.
You're welcome to come
back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是你的铝。
欢迎随时回来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're kidding me, right?
I just told you that I need 5 Rough Eluniums to make a pure Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在开玩笑吧？
我刚才才告诉你，我需要5块铝原石才能制作1块纯铝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Enchanted Stones...?
I've been a stonesmith for 20 years, so I've heard a lot about them. Supposedly, there are
four different kinds.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
属性原石...？
我做石匠20年了，听过不少关于它们的事，据说一共有四种。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Each Enchanted Stone possesses one of the following elemental properties: Earth, Wind, Water and Fire.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
每种属性原石都拥有地、风、水、火四种属性之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If someone combines a Enchanted Stone with a weapon while smithing, that weapon will possess the same property as the Stone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
锻造武器时加入属性原石，就能让武器获得相同的属性。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Needless to say, you need to have some smithing skill to produce this kind of elemental weapon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用说，你需要具备一定的锻造技能才能制作这种属性武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey there!
Do you want me
to repair any items?
You can count on me
for item repairs!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你好！
你想让我修复什么物品吗？
物品修复就交给我吧！

scripts.text: Actually, I do have some items...
scripts.translation: 我确实有一些物品...

scripts.text: None at the moment.
scripts.translation: 暂时没有

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh wow, this is incredible!
You must take very good care of your things. None of your items are damaged!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇哦，这太不可思议了！
你一定非常爱惜你的东西。你的物品都没有损坏！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If everyone is like you, I'm going to be unemployed!! Haha~!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
人人都像你这样爱惜装备，我可就要失业了！！Haha~!

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
Let's see...
Out of all your items,
{1} are damaged.
Would you like to repair?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...让我看看...
你有{1}件物品损坏了，要修理吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Each repair costs {1} Zeny. So to repair all your damaged items would cost {2} Zeny! Would you like to repair the items?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
每件修理费{1} Zeny，全部修好需要{2} Zeny！
要修理吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa whoa...
Check your wallet before you receive the repair bill! I can't repair anything because you don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎哎...先看看钱包吧，你的Zeny不够，我没法修理。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay! All done. Now, try to be a little more careful. Items have lives too you know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，全修好了。
以后小心点，物品也是有生命的嘛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mmm? Something's wrong. Wait... Equip the items you need to repair and then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？有点不对劲。等等...请装备你需要修复的物品，然后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it's no skin off my nose, but it's not good to leave items damaged. You should get them repaired as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，虽然对我来说没什么大不了的，但让物品保持损坏状态是不好的。你应该尽快去修复它们！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hohoho...
You don't have
any business with me
if you don't have any
items to repair.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
Hohoho...
没东西要修，我们也就没什么生意好谈了。
